description: This file contains utility methods related to handling Android ContentInfo objects, including partitioning content based on predicates and collecting URIs from ClipData.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for content partitioning and URI collection.

methods.name: partition
methods.description: Splits a ContentInfo payload into two ContentInfo objects based on a predicate applied to each ClipData.Item.

methods.name: buildClipData
methods.description: Constructs a ClipData object from a description and a list of items.

methods.name: collectUris
methods.description: Extracts all non-null URIs from a ClipData object.
